component.name: Persistwise
component.summary: A personal web archive that runs on your own computer

description.p: Persistwise Desktop saves full copies of web pages on your own computer: text, styles, images and fonts in one file that opens offline. Browse and search everything you saved, with no account and no servers.
Optional backups, all set up by you:

ul.li: Send pages to the Wayback Machine through the Internet Archive's public Save Page Now.
Pin saved copies to IPFS with your own node (IPFS Desktop or Kubo) or your own pinning key.

description.p: It can also import an export of a Persistwise web account, so your archive can live entirely on your machine.
First version: local full-page saves, offline browse and search, optional Wayback and IPFS backups, and Persistwise web export import.
